zh-CN.title: 表情集合与轻巧面板
items: 探索改为单层导航，手机表情面板更轻巧，小哀增加官方标记
支持全屏制作自己的表情集合，上传与首页分开，发布和更新经过审核
活动素材统一云端管理，减少前端随包资源

en.title: Sticker collections, lighter picker
items: Explore uses one navigation row; the mobile picker is shorter and Ai has an official mark
Create collections in fullscreen; uploads stay separate from My home, with reviewed publishing and updates
Activity artwork and audio now use a shared cloud resource library
